name: posh
description: Gives Codex version-matched Ruby and gem API documentation and prompts it to check it before relying on memory. Requires POSH to be installed and activated.

interface.shortDescription: Version-matched Ruby API docs for AI coding
interface.longDescription: Give Codex Ruby, Rails, and gem API documentation matched to the project's Ruby version and Gemfile.lock. Read focused sections to save tokens, reduce risk with prompt-injection scanning, and ground code in matching APIs to help avoid version-mismatch correction loops. Documentation lookups run locally after syncing. Scanning does not eliminate risk; retrieved docs remain untrusted data. Prompts Codex to check documentation before relying on memory.
defaultPrompt: Check the POSH docs before changing this Rails code.
Find what changed in this gem's changelog for our version.
